mapper.select: SELECT clinic_id FROM t_employee_clinic WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT c.id, c.parent_id, c.clinic_name, c.clinic_code, c.short_name, c.contact_name, c.contact_phone, c.province, c.city, c.district, c.address, c.business_hours, c.logo, c.sort_order, c.status, c.open_date, c.remark FROM t_employee_clinic ec INNER JOIN t_clinic c ON ec.clinic_id = c.id AND c.is_delete = 0 WHERE ec.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND c.status = 0 ORDER BY c.sort_order ASC, c.id ASC

SELECT employee_id, clinic_id FROM t_employee_clinic WHERE employee_id IN
#{id}
